scientific_integrity: Original partition-function and single-setting Fisher-metric formulas of Ebadi et al. are credited. The paired-field design theorem is derived and checked separately; independent audit has not been performed. Prior art may contain unindexed equivalent optimizations.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes independent fully resolved classical triangle-spin snapshots, equal-magnitude opposite known fields, local design at a zero common offset, and fixed nominal exchange coupling. It does not optimize unrestricted multisetting experiments or claim a physical thermodynamic phase transition.
title: Opposite-field probing preserves joint information in a frustrated Ising trimer
